title: BLANK () || BLANK () is FALSE, not BLANK

source.quote: only when both expressions are FALSE is the result FALSE
a BLANK in a logical expression is converted to a FALSE value
source.supports: a logical expression returns TRUE or FALSE; BLANK counts as FALSE
the other reading: the table of BLANK in operations gives BLANK for BLANK OR BLANK

derivation: || returns TRUE if either side is TRUE and FALSE when both are FALSE. BLANK counts as FALSE, so the result is FALSE, and ISBLANK of FALSE is FALSE.
alternative: Microsoft's table of BLANK in operations lists BLANK OR BLANK as BLANK. Under that reading ISBLANK gives TRUE.
